profit_quality.assessment: No positive sustainable distributable cash-profit denominator is established. The latest two years reported operating losses and attributable losses. Positive operating cash flow in FY2024 and FY2023 was mainly working-capital release, while FY2022 profit converted into negative operating cash flow because receivables and inventories consumed cash.
adjustments: Added back HK$19.000m FY2024 investment-property fair-value loss as a non-cash item when assessing operating sustainability, but the adjusted business still lacks a positive recurring profit base.
Rejected FY2024 operating cash flow as a sustainable denominator because HK$73.438m of working-capital release exceeded net operating cash generated from operations.
Rejected FY2023 operating cash flow as a sustainable denominator because HK$210.046m of working-capital release supported cash flow despite a reported loss.
Used three-year profit and cash-flow evidence; because the median attributable profit and median operating profit are negative, discounted sustainable distributable cash profit is null.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 OCF HK$52.832m after HK$73.438m working-capital release; 2023 OCF HK$185.545m after HK$210.046m working-capital release; 2022 OCF negative HK$76.621m despite profit.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: The denominator is not a low-quality positive profit that can be haircut; it is not established because recent ordinary operations are loss-making and cash inflows are dominated by working-capital release.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Cash conversion is volatile and mainly driven by inventory/receivable movement rather than recurring profit.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: FY2024 property, plant and equipment acquisition cash outflow was HK$8.821m; maintenance/growth split not disclosed.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital is material for a metal trading business and swung from HK$106.249m cash consumption in FY2022 to HK$210.046m release in FY2023 and HK$73.438m release in FY2024.
